tables.name: Specialty
tables.description: The main thing the town is known for. A town with the Production priority rolls a d4 instead of a d8.

results.name: Craft
results.description: The town is known for being a place to find high-quality, hand-crafted goods.

results.name: Farming or Resource Gathering
results.description: The town is known for the resource(s) it produces. Base this on what kind of environment and climate the town is in. If farming wouldn’t work as well, perhaps they mine or harvest lumber instead. (+1 to farms and resources roll. Reroll if 1-8.)

results.name: Industry
results.description: This town is known for certain industrial processes such as milling, textiles, or smelting. (Free Location: Shop - [d6]: 1-2: Mill 3-4: Textile Production 5-6: Foundry/Smelting)

results.name: Unique Shipping Methods
results.description: These people know how to get things from one place to another by strange or innovative means.

results.name: Connections
results.description: This town is full of people who can find and obtain almost anything (or, perhaps, anyone).

results.name: Drink
results.description: The town is known for having a wide variety of (or excellent quality) beverages available throughout.

results.name: Education
results.description: The town is known as the location of a widely-renowned educational institution. (Free Location: Non-Commercial - Place of Education)

results.name: Hospitality
results.description: The town is known as a welcoming, desirable place to stay. (The default inn is of [d6]: 1-3: good quality 4-6: fine quality)
